security_findings.scope: Read-only source finding; no credential was printed or accessed, no git clone was run, and no bot or live service was invoked.
security_findings.mechanism: The git_clone branch reads GITHUB_TOKEN, inserts it into an HTTPS URL, and passes that credential-bearing URL to git clone as a subprocess argument. The token is therefore observable in child-process argv during cloning, and Git records the supplied origin URL in the destination .git/config; the clone branch has no post-clone remote cleanup. The push path repeats token-bearing URL handling.
security_findings.impact: Source proves an exposure path through process inspection and repository metadata; it does not prove a real token leaked from the deployed runtime.
remediation: Remove tokens from URLs and argv entirely.
Use a scoped Git credential helper or ephemeral GIT_ASKPASS/equivalent protected credential mechanism with a clean HTTPS remote.
Clear the helper after the operation and redact command/error diagnostics.
Ensure cloned and pushed remotes remain credential-free in .git/config.
tests_required: Mock subprocess execution and assert the token never appears in clone or push argv.
Exercise failure output and assert credential material is not returned to Telegram or logs.
Verify a temporary clone's origin in .git/config is credential-free.
Add a static guard rejecting token interpolation into Git URLs.
security_findings.approval_relation: Credential handling remediation is separate from the mgmt-bot producer-approval question and does not mandate a second approval gate.

audit.conclusion: The 18 live versions in this platform slice are reconciled, but current in SkilzVolt does not prove installation, execution, scheduling, delivery, or readback. Source review confirms one high-severity mgmt-bot credential-handling vulnerability in the GitHub clone path: GITHUB_TOKEN is placed in a Git URL passed to a child process and is persisted by Git in .git/config; no live leak was established. No production repair was made.

test_policy.reason: Read-only audit boundary; no workflows, live APIs, OAuth, schedulers, services, deployments, or app tests were run.

skills.name: app-plan
skills.trigger: New app/project planning, scope clarification, or a build/test/deploy path; also external/client project setup.
skills.invocation_wiring: Manual prompt contract; generic filesystem prompt and slash-command discovery only; no command dispatch.
skills.executor_owner: Model/manual planner; user owns product intent and non-obvious scope; downstream app skills or named external agent execute.
skills.input_evidence_contract: Change, audience, code home, new-versus-patch, acceptance criteria, proof artifact, repo/update path, and control-plane/preview path.
skills.approval_final_executor: User approves scope/plan; planner cannot silently choose architecture, ownership, hosting, or operator workflow.
skills.destination_readback: Plan/spec/project control-plane record is required by the contract, but no product-owned plan store or readback module is present.
skills.tests_gaps: Generic skill-loader tests exist; no app-plan executor test, current-body installation proof, control-plane record, or plan receipt.

skills.name: google-auth
skills.trigger: Google Calendar/Gmail token missing, revoked, stale, or failing refresh; stale feed caused by auth.
skills.invocation_wiring: Manual skill route; installer deploys Google poller snapshots and user systemd services; no remote-body-to-service registration.
skills.executor_owner: Human completes Google consent; calendar/Gmail pollers refresh and write feeds; systemd owns restart.
skills.input_evidence_contract: Poller references/logs, credentials and token files, and the exact OAuth callback; fail closed if service/feed is not refreshed.
skills.approval_final_executor: Human OAuth consent; poller after service restart is final executor, not token creation alone.
skills.destination_readback: Calendar/Gmail tokens, generated calendar/mail feeds, service status, and logs.
skills.tests_gaps: No dedicated Google-auth test. Contract says phone-first and references an auth helper not found in checkout; poller source documents local-server/SSH-tunnel flow. Service/feed was not live-checked.

skills.name: transcript-resource
skills.trigger: Pasted transcript/notes, meeting/workshop/interview transcript, YouTube URL, or explicit save/store request.
skills.invocation_wiring: Manual contract prefers native YouTube capability then resource filing; native extraction is wired but retention and downstream updates are not one native module.
skills.executor_owner: Model/manual classifier and file writer; optional external CRM/SharePoint queue/processor.
skills.input_evidence_contract: Full raw text/URL; filename is only a clue; content and calendar corroboration establish date/entity/home; route overrides and ambiguity questions are mandatory.
skills.approval_final_executor: User clarifies material ambiguity; final completion requires full artifact retention and CRM plus SharePoint current-truth updates when applicable.

skills.name: mgmt-bot
skills.trigger: Explicit controlled dev command or management-bot request; distinguish Pi Telegram bot from local .dev-cmd workflow.
skills.invocation_wiring: Installer-wired/generated route: installer links the separate Telegram bot and generates a user systemd service; enable/restart is conditional on environment variables, and the .dev-cmd queue scanner runs every main-loop cycle. Live activation remains unverified.
skills.executor_owner: L1/model writes queue JSON; Python management bot validates and executes an allowlisted git/npm operation.
skills.input_evidence_contract: Queue file project/operation/args/message/timestamp; project path constrained to workspace/projects; operation allowlist.
skills.approval_final_executor: Skill requires Tom confirmation before queueing. The consumer has no visible approval field and executes a queued file it sees; this demonstrates executor behavior, not that the producer bypasses its approval contract. Producer confirmation and an end-to-end approval receipt are unproven; pause/resume is separate.
skills.destination_readback: Queue file consumed/deleted, Telegram result, and git/npm changes in project directory.
skills.tests_gaps: No mgmt-bot queue/approval or credential-argument test. The confirmed source credential-exposure path, active service, token, chat authorization, producer approval, queue receipt, and end-to-end approval behavior were not live-tested.

prioritized_repairs.action: Document active agent/config scope for SkilzVolt, prove metadata injection plus current-body read through owner-only adapter, and prevent installer snapshots being mistaken for current remote versions.
Align portable paths and phone-first callback handling with the actual poller, remove absent-helper reference, and add offline token/service/feed-readback tests.

Trace the .dev-cmd.json producer write path and capture the confirmation/approval receipt end to end. Add a queue gate only if that producer invariant is not proven; do not infer bypass from the consumer's lack of an approval field.
Separate native extraction from durable filing and test raw preservation, calendar corroboration, queue readback, CRM update, and SharePoint current-truth completion.
Resolve skill-creator's SharePoint-manifest requirement against skill-update's current rejection of retired SharePoint authority.
Add safe offline tests for YouTube URL/fallback/cache/truncation, Whisper failures, Codex profile shapes, and mgmt queue allowlisting.
Define durable plan/build/test/deploy and bootstrap discoverability receipts if these skills are intended as product workflows rather than prompt-only guidance.
